pitch:
# A booking page for a hair salon

## 1. People and their journey
**Client** (the only role). Arrives wanting a haircut or treatment without phoning. Sees the services and durations, picks one, picks a day and an open time, enters name, phone and email, submits, and sees a confirmation that the request is received. Done.

Salon staff confirm requests; they are outside the interface and have no screens.

## 2. How it looks
A single calm, light page like a simple appointment-booking form: a centred column of three numbered cards on a warm off-white backdrop.

- **Page backdrop**: fills the screen, flat warm off-white (#FAF6F1).
- **Header**: top of the column, flat, salon-plum (#5B2A4A) text on the backdrop, shows the page title "Book an appointment".
- **Service list**: card 1, white, raised with a soft shadow, one row per service showing name, duration and a radio mark. Hover: pale plum tint (#F3E8EF). Selected: plum outline and filled radio.
- **Day strip**: card 2, white raised, shows the next 14 days as small buttons with weekday and date. Today has a thin plum ring. Selected: filled plum with white text. Days with no free times: grey text (#9A9A9A), unavailable. Locked with greyed look until a service is chosen.
- **Time slot grid**: card 2, below the day strip, wrapped buttons showing times. Free: white, plum outline. Hover: pale plum fill. Selected: filled plum, white text. Taken: grey fill (#E6E2DE), struck-through text, unavailable. Empty day: the grid shows "No times left this day".
- **Contact form**: card 3, white raised, fields Name, Phone, Email, with labels above and grey outlined boxes. Focus: plum outline. Error: red (#B3261E) outline with red message under the field. Locked until a time is chosen.
- **Summary line**: above the submit button, flat text showing the chosen service, day, time and duration.
- **Submit button**: bottom of card 3, plum fill, white text "Request booking". Hover: darker plum (#44203A). Disabled: pale grey until the form is complete. Sending: label "Sending…" and not pressable.
- **Confirmation panel**: replaces the cards after success, white raised, green (#2E7D4F) tick, shows the booking details and the status "Requested", and a "Book another" button in plum outline.
- **Failure notice**: red-tinted banner above the button when sending fails or the slot was just taken, showing the reason.

## 3. How it is used
- Click or tap a service row: selects it and unlocks the day strip.
- Click or tap a day: selects it and shows its time slots for that service.
- Click or tap a free time slot: selects it and unlocks the contact form.
- Click or tap a selected service, day or slot again: nothing changes.
- Click or tap a different choice: replaces the choice; changing the service or day clears the chosen time.
- Type in Name, Phone, Email: fills the field; errors show when leaving the field.
- Press Tab and Enter or Space: reach and choose any option with the keyboard.
- Click or tap "Request booking": validates and sends; on success shows the confirmation.
- Click or tap "Book another": clears everything and returns to the service list.

## 4. Scope
One loop: choose service, day, time, enter contact details, submit, see confirmation. Left out: stylist choice, payments, products, loyalty.

## 5. Things and their states
- **Service**: name, duration in minutes. Fixed.
- **Time slot**: date, start time, state free or taken. Free becomes taken when a booking is requested for it.
- **Booking**: service, slot, client name, phone, email, status. Starts **requested** on submit; staff (outside the interface) move it to **confirmed**.

## 6. Rules
- A slot is offered only if the service's full duration fits before closing; otherwise it is not shown as free.
- Only free slots can be selected; taken slots ignore clicks.
- Steps unlock in order: service, day, time, details; locked steps ignore clicks.
- Name is required, at least 2 characters; otherwise an error shows and nothing is sent.
- Phone is required, 7–15 digits (spaces, +, dashes allowed); otherwise refused with an error.
- Email is required and must look like an address; otherwise refused with an error.
- Only dates from today to 13 days ahead are offered; past times today are taken.
- If the chosen slot was taken meanwhile, the submit is refused, the failure notice appears and the time list refreshes.
- Double-pressing submit creates only one booking.
- A new booking has status requested, and the confirmation shows it as "Requested".
- The page never shows a booking as confirmed to the client until staff confirm it.
domain_name: A booking page for a hair salon
entities_block:
- **Service** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, name: string, duration_minutes: int]
- **TimeSlot** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, slot_date: datetime, start_time: datetime, state: string]
- **BookingRequest** (created by audience): [id: string, service_id: string, time_slot_id: string, client_name: string, client_phone: string, client_email: string, status: string, created_at: datetime]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Offer slot only if full service duration fits before closing] (TimeSlot): Given a service with a duration of 60 minutes and a day closing at 18:00 When the time slots for that day are generated Then a slot starting at 17:30 is not offered as free and a slot starting at 17:00 is offered as free
- [Only free slots can be selected] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot in the taken state When the client selects it Then the selection is ignored and the contact step stays locked; Given a time slot in the free state When the client selects it Then it becomes the chosen time
- [Taken slot is displayed as unavailable] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot in the taken state When the time slot grid is displayed Then the slot appears grey, struck-through and unavailable
- [Free slot is displayed as selectable] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot in the free state When the time slot grid is displayed Then the slot appears white with a plum outline; When the client hovers over it Then it shows a pale plum fill; When selected Then it shows filled plum with white text
- [Steps unlock in strict order] (BookingRequest): Given no service is chosen When the client selects a day or time or types in the contact form Then the action is ignored; Given a service is chosen When the client selects a day Then the day strip is unlocked and the day is selected
- [Locked day strip and contact form presentation] (BookingRequest): Given no service has been chosen When the page is displayed Then the day strip appears greyed and locked; Given no time has been chosen When the page is displayed Then the contact form appears locked
- [Reselecting the same choice changes nothing] (BookingRequest): Given a service is already selected When the client selects the same service again Then the selection does not change
- [Changing service or day clears chosen time] (BookingRequest): Given a time slot has been chosen When the client selects a different service Then the chosen time is cleared; Given a time slot has been chosen When the client selects a different day Then the chosen time is cleared
- [Date window of today to 13 days ahead] (TimeSlot): Given today is the current date When the day strip is shown Then it offers exactly 14 days from today to today plus 13; Given a date 14 days ahead When offered Then it is not offered
- [Past times today are taken] (TimeSlot): Given the current time is 14:00 When the slots for today are listed Then slots before 14:00 are taken and cannot be selected
- [Empty day message] (TimeSlot): Given a selected day with no free times When the time grid is displayed Then it shows 'No times left this day' and the day is shown with grey unavailable text in the day strip
- [Name validation] (BookingRequest): Given a name of 1 character When the client leaves the field Then an error is shown and submission sends nothing; Given a name of 2 or more characters When submitted Then the name is accepted
- [Phone validation] (BookingRequest): Given a phone of 6 digits When submitted Then the booking is refused with a phone error; Given a phone of '+44 20-7946-0958' When submitted Then the phone is accepted
- [Email validation] (BookingRequest): Given an email 'client-at-example' When submitted Then the booking is refused with an email error; Given an email 'client@example.com' When submitted Then the email is accepted
- [Field error presentation] (BookingRequest): Given an invalid value in a contact field When the client leaves the field Then the field shows a red outline and a red message below it; When the field is focused Then it shows a plum outline
- [Slot taken meanwhile refuses submit] (BookingRequest): Given a chosen slot that another client has just booked When the client presses Request booking Then no booking is created, the failure notice shows that the slot was just taken, and the time list refreshes
- [Double submit creates one booking] (BookingRequest): Given a valid completed form When the client presses Request booking twice in quick succession Then exactly one booking request is created
- [New booking starts as requested] (BookingRequest): Given a valid booking form and a free slot When the client submits Then a booking is created with status requested and the slot becomes taken
- [Confirmation shows Requested status] (BookingRequest): Given a booking was successfully submitted When the confirmation is displayed Then it shows the booking details and status 'Requested' with a green tick and a 'Book another' button
- [Never show booking as confirmed to client] (BookingRequest): Given a booking with status requested When the client views the page or confirmation Then the status shown is 'Requested' and never 'Confirmed'
- [Failure notice on send failure] (BookingRequest): Given a valid form When sending fails Then a red-tinted failure notice with the reason appears above the Request booking button and no booking is created
- [Submit button enabled only when form complete] (BookingRequest): Given the contact form is incomplete When the page is displayed Then the button is pale grey and disabled; Given a submit is in progress When the button is shown Then it reads 'Sending…' and is not pressable
- [Book another resets the journey] (BookingRequest): Given the confirmation panel is shown When the client clicks Book another Then all selections and inputs are cleared and the service list is shown
intent_block:
- Product type: customer_app
- Audience: Hair salon clients booking appointments
- Goal: Let clients see available appointment times and book a hair salon service without phoning the salon.
- Scope: A single booking page where clients choose a service and time slot and submit their contact details to create a booking.
- The model must cover: Services offered and their durations; Available appointment time slots; Client booking requests with contact details; Booking status (requested or confirmed)
- Do NOT model: Staff rosters and stylist assignment; Online payments and deposits; Inventory and product sales; Client loyalty programmes
